limitations: The entrance and plaza elevations, intermediate tread dimensions and west stair count are fitted from ordinary photographs and the standard terrain. Exterior accessibility hardware and exact elevation survey remain outside this reconstruction.
The museum exterior retains photo-led shell profiles, gallery heights and joints. La Salve Bridge, independent artworks and museum interiors remain separate.

appearance.identity: Guggenheim Bilbao’s titanium shells, limestone galleries, eastern fins, lantern and river canopy, with the lower glazed entrance, 41-step city-side stair, western promenade flight and bounded entrance paving.
appearance.master: The lowered entrance includes the curved limestone treads, lower glass portal, upper plaza and slim rails.
appearance.browser: Each level preserves the open lower court and the descent. The two nearest levels retain all 41 treads.
